data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hello,

The fund's most recent 13F (period June 30, 2026) shows positions in FSBW, PLBC, and ORN.

On October 15, ORN disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1402829/000140282926000054/orn-20261012x8k.htm).

Would you like the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
